scope: single complete 180-second trial for balanced and quality, with explicit strict NPU/hardware/AV1 overrides for controlled codec comparison; not three-trial headline evidence

environment.processor: Snapdragon(R) X Plus - X1P42100 - Qualcomm(R) Oryon(TM) CPU

trials.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version n9.0.1-11-ge47273f4d9-20260831 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
trials.frame_latency_scope: raw read start through encoder pipe submission; excludes encoder completion

input.method: all packet presentation timestamps; actual pipeline frame count required
input.limitation: Packet inspection does not prove decoded pixel integrity.

output.method: all packet presentation timestamps; actual pipeline frame count required
output.limitation: Packet inspection does not prove decoded pixel integrity.

trials.total_seconds_scope: process_video function; excludes CLI import, printing and JSON

resources.scope: Python + decoder + encoder; 1s sampled working set, CPU deltas between samples; excludes other apps

trials.resource_sample_scope: 1s Windows process CPU/working set; last 7200 samples; no process IDs

sustained.scope: encoder pipe submissions, windows on 1s boundaries; first window includes codec startup, final includes flush; encoder completion timing not available
sustained.throughput_history_scope: last 600 complete seconds; minimum retained for whole run

trials.timing_scope: decode process start through encoder flush; excludes initialization, output validation and hashing
trials.pipe_timings: read/write blocking time, not isolated hardware codec execution time

balanced.aggregation: median across complete measured trials; startup separate
